title: NEW: Girdwood Views and Brews with Aerial Tram and Brewery
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Views and Brews Tour takes you on a scenic drive down the Turnagain Arm to the quaint ski town of Girdwood. 
Take the Alyeska Aerial Tram to the top of the mountain to enjoy stunning views with a brew at the Bore Tide Bar. 
Later, we’ll experience the highly renowned and award-winning Girdwood Brewing. Back in Anchorage, your guide will be happy to drop you off at one of the many local breweries, restaurants, or safely back to your hotel.
